title: Romantic Vietnam | FREE Ba Na Hills Cable Car Tickets
highlights: Explore the bustling markets of Hanoi, sail through the serene waters of Halong Bay, and visit the iconic gems of Hoi An with your loved one on this trip to Vietnam.
Cruise through the breathtaking Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for its limestone caves and emerald tinted waters.
Pay homage to the nation's leader at the historic Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and immerse yourself in the bustling atmosphere of the Old Quarter in Hanoi.
Navigate through the narrow passages and witness hidden bunkers in the underground world of the Cu Chi Tunnels, a 250-kilometre network.
Soar through the clouds on a romantic cable car ride to Ba Na Hills while enjoying panoramic views of lush rainforests and cascading waterfalls.
overview:
About the tour:
Vietnam boasts stunning landscapes, from lush rice paddies to pristine beaches and towering mountains. Explore vibrant cities like Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, steeped in history and culture. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Discover the charm of Hoi An, a UNESCO World Heritage town renowned for its architecture and bespoke tailoring. Savor delicious cuisine, encounter warm hospitality, and create lasting memories in this captivating country with a perfectly planned Vietnam trip.


From mountains to coast, Vietnam offers something for everyone. Whether you seek adventure, relaxation, or cultural immersion, this Southeast Asian gem promises an unforgettable journey. Experience the lively cities, explore breathtaking landscapes, and indulge in Vietnam’s rich heritage. For those planning a romantic escape, Vietnam couple packages offer the perfect blend of scenic beauty, cultural charm, and intimate experiences.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon reaching the Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi, get transferred to your hotel. Relax for a while and spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring the local attractions on your own. Step back in time at 87 Ma May Street, a century-old house showcasing Hanoi's architectural heritage. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Embark on a journey to Halong Bay as your check out from the hotel and take a pre-booked transfer. Board your cruise from Tuan Chau Harbour and set sail amidst the limestone karsts (rock formations). Explore Ti Top Island, visit the Pearl Farm Village, and enjoy water activities like kayaking and swimming. Learn the culinary secrets of Vietnamese cuisine with an onboard cooking class. Conclude the day with an overnight stay on the cruise, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Halong Bay.

Hanoi to Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay, and enjoy the Vietnamese lunch. Witness the natural beauty of Thien Canh Son Cave, the most beautiful cave in the bay.
Explore the BainTu Long Bay and indulge in water activities, or relax by the beach. Later, enjoy the sunset from the cruise and join cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food.
Enjoy your dinner. Later, indulge in fun activities like Karaoke programs, star watching and more. Overnight stay on the cruise in Halong Bay.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Begin your day with a rejuvenating Tai Chi martial art lesson on the cruise, followed by a visit to the enchanting Floating Village. Post that, deboard the cruise, get transferred to Hanoi and check in at the hotel. Spend the remaining day exploring the city's famous attractions. Go on a shopping spree in Dong Xuan Market and get a glimpse into history with a visit to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. Conclude the day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Enjoy the Tai Chi session on the cruise before breakfast. Visit one of the biggest villages, Vung Vieng floating fishing village. Learn about the lifestyle of the villagers and indulge in water activities like kayaking or bamboo boating.
Return to the cruise, relax, and enjoy your brunch before reaching Taun Chan Bay.

days.title: Hanoi Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Da Nang
days.desc: Get ready for a sightseeing tour of Hanoi as you check out from the hotel and board your pre-booked transfer. Explore famous attractions like One Pillar Pagoda, Chua Tran Quoc, Old Quarter, and Huc Bridge. Following the sightseeing tour, get transferred to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang International Airport. Upon arrival in Da Nang, get transferred to the hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Ba Na Hills
days.desc: On this day, embark on a thrilling day trip to Ba Na Hills. Depart from your hotel and get transferred to Suoi Mo Station to enjoy a cable car ride to the summit. Head to the Linh Ung Pagoda and witness panoramic views of the South China Sea from there. Also, learn the secrets of winemaking at the Debay Wine Cellar and experience thrilling rides in Fantasy Park. Following that, visit the famous Golden Hand Bridge. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hoi An | Transfer to Ho Chi Minh
days.desc: Conclude your stay in Da Nang by checking out and getting driven to the charming town of Hoi An. Explore the town's rich history and architecture by visiting iconic attractions such as the Japanese Covered Bridge and the Assembly Hall of Fujian Chinese, and the Museum of Sa Huynh Culture. Later, get driven to Da Nang International Airport for your onward flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Upon arrival at Tan Son Nhat International Airport, get transferred to the hotel and check in for overnight stay.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City tour with Cu Chi Tunnels
days.desc: On this day, get transferred to explore the Cu Chi Tunnels, an underground network which played an important role in the Vietnam War. Then, continue for a sightseeing tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Visit the Reunification Palace and later, see powerful exhibits and artefacts of the Vietnam War at the War Remnants Museum. Also, admire the iconic Saigon Central Post Office, a masterpiece of French colonial architecture. Conclude the day by getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.
